# local-codebase-indexer

> Trace SQL Server tables and stored procedures to C# callers, controller actions and Razor pages in a local source tree. MCP server and CLI with confidence labels. Static analysis; verify inferred edges in source.

Install: `pip install local-codebase-indexer`, then `local-codebase-indexer demo` for a bundled synthetic example. For your source tree: `local-codebase-indexer --root <project> data-access <table>`.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): install, commands, MCP registration, how to read confidence levels
- [README.md](README.md): features, design, known limits
- [TODO.md](TODO.md): planned work
- [benchmarks/README.md](benchmarks/README.md): how search quality is measured
